WARDEN

A VPN that finds its own servers, ranks them by threat, and rotates without asking.

install self-test github

Install.

Pick a platform:

platform
curl -fsSL https://github.com/Fakeonomics/Warden/releases/latest/download/warden-x86_64-linux.AppImage -o warden.AppImage && chmod +x warden.AppImage
AppImage deb dmg exe
or download AppImage

Self-test.

One command checks every layer: tunnel handshake, AI reasoning, OPSEC, discovery.

warden self-test ternary=true opsec_persist=true tunnel_proof=Some((32, 32, 32, 32)) SERVICE OK
